paragraphs.text: This is a repository of locations of unknown origin . These locations are named or referenced but it is unclear from their source whether they are a plane or merely a location on a plane.

Akkurdal 's plane, home to elves , demons , horses , land leeches , swamp- sharks , and water dragons . The Great Waste, formerly the Great Plains. Eredok, a village of three hundred farmers, hunters, and craftsfolk, where Akkurdal grew up. The Great River, flowed past Eredok Kresh Lugul Mountains of Shenggor, beyond the Great Waste
Alberix, the Trade Planet
The Bastion of Suns and the Ota
The Church of the Incarnate Soul 's plane. The Ethereal Temple
Cyristiii Viroscek - an ancient battleground
Dweldians and the Realm of Thrones
Elagia - a place where four-armed swamp swallowers live, a place known to Oko .
Everlorne - a land ruled by the wizard Noranda-Zang . It had forests of juniper and holly and yellow-green plains with a stone fortress. Its swamps were home to gnats and bitterweed.
The Fatemerge, the Old Mountains, and the Constellari
Flat Sky and the Rahode tribe
Grag Ridge, located on a plane with humans, orcs, and goblins
Great Threshold of Monserkat

"The Green Mana Plane", with more than two moons, home to bowlidders, draylobes, dells, floryndines, fritch bugs, ice snappers, mirror demons, needle corn, quizzles, twig dragons, and creatures that call themselves human but are short and quadrupedal, hairless, with thick legs, longer necks that can rotate their heads to the rear, snouts, fangs, and claws. Home of the Erlundi Minotaurs
The Infinite Consortium 's desert headquarters plane The Iron Tower
The Infinite Consortium 's icy mining operations plane The Ashadris River The Kankarras Mountains.
Indigo, an island of fewmen (human/elf mixed heritage) fishermen
Jornald's Arms and Armor
Kartya is an island on an unknown plane, the home of the Planeswalker Rafthrasa , who wanted to live there as a mortal farmer.
Kell Phir - a place with poppy dens that Elspeth has been to.
The Ki-Tirn mountains, Karshan 's haven; the Sharnward Swamp, at the base of the Ki-Tirn range; the Grand Plains; and Tullor, home of orcs.
Lume, on the homeplane of Bruenna , Dwugget , Lyese , and Raksha Golden Cub .
The Church of the Incarnate Soul 's plane.
The Nut Hoard of the Fallen Oaks
The Outer Ring, a possible plane fought over by planeswalkers, previously controlled by Brand .
Plav(ia), the source of Plavian bees. Possibly on Cridhe.
The Ridgeback Mountains and the Umbra Forest
Scrub Isle and the Crimson and Azure Fleets
Tharkair, where Nimbys is from
Valley of Echoes - a place Karn and Venser explored together, where Karn found a scroll that he was surprised to be able to read, while Venser could not.
Vex - a place of demons where Davriel Cane spent some time, and from where he obtained a shadow charm.
Zarnic - a place known to Elspeth , that features devils .
